Property.name: TargetConfigNames
Property.Description: Configuration item(s) to which to send messages

Method.name: OnRequest
Method.Implementation:
If pRequest.DocTypeName = "BHS" { $$$TRACE("Create batch header segments ...") Do ##class(IHC.ITF.Transform.BatchHl7.DTL.FHS).Transform(pRequest,.tFHS) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.Transform.BatchHl7.DTL.BHS).Transform(pRequest,.tBHS)
Set tSegment = ##class(EnsLib.HL7.Segment).%New() Set tSegment.Separators=tBHS.Separators Do tSegment.SetValueAt("MessageDocsRef"_tSegment.FS_2) Do tBHS.InsertSegmentAt(tSegment,2) Do tBHS.RemoveSegmentAt(3) Set tBTS=##class(EnsLib.HL7.Segment).%New() Set tBTS.Separators=tBHS.Separators Do tBTS.SetValueAt("BTS"_tBTS.FS_tBHS.ChildCount) Do tBHS.SetSegmentAt(tBTS,3) Set tSC= tBHS.%Save() Set ^BatchHL7("BHSId") = tBHS.%Id()
Set tSegment = ##class(EnsLib.HL7.Segment).%New() Set tSegment.Separators=tBHS.Separators Do tSegment.SetValueAt("BHSDocsRef"_tSegment.FS_2) Do tFHS.InsertSegmentAt(tSegment,2) Do tFHS.AddChild(2, tBHS)
Do tFHS.RemoveSegmentAt(3) Set tFTS=##class(EnsLib.HL7.Segment).%New() Set tFTS.Separators=tFHS.Separators Do tFTS.SetValueAt("FTS"_tFTS.FS_tFHS.ChildCount) Do tFHS.SetSegmentAt(tFTS,3)
Set tSC = tFHS.%Save() Set ^BatchHL7("FHSId") = tFHS.%Id() } ElseIf pRequest.DocTypeName = "BTS" { $$$TRACE("Create batch tailer segments ...") Set tFHS = ##class(EnsLib.HL7.Message).%OpenId(^BatchHL7("FHSId")) Set tSC = ..SendRequestAsync(..TargetConfigNames,tFHS,0) } Else { $$$TRACE("Add message to the batch ...") Set tBHS = ##class(EnsLib.HL7.Message).%OpenId(^BatchHL7("BHSId")) Do tBHS.AddChild(2,pRequest) Set tBTS=##class(EnsLib.HL7.Segment).%New() Set tBTS.Separators=tBHS.Separators
Do tBTS.SetValueAt("BTS"_tBTS.FS_tBHS.ChildCount) Do tBHS.SetSegmentAt(tBTS,3)
Set tSC = tBHS.%Save() } Quit tSC
